name: Adatanserin
summary: Adatanserin (WY-50,324, SEB-324) is a mixed 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist and 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor antagonist. It was under development by Wyeth as an antidepressant but was ultimately not pursued.

pharmacology.text: Adatanserin (WY-50,324, SEB-324) is a mixed 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist and 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor antagonist. Adantaserin has been shown to be neuroprotective against ischemia-induced glutamatergic excitotoxicity, an effect which appears to be mediated by blockade of the 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist; Serotonin 5-HT2C receptor antagonist

uses.text: It was under development by Wyeth as an antidepressant but was ultimately not pursued.

summaryZh: 阿達色林是一種混合的5-HT1A受體部分激動劑以及5-HT2A和5-HT2C受體拮抗劑。惠氏公司試圖將其開發為抗抑鬱藥，但最終沒有得到推廣。
summaryZhHans: 阿达色林是一种混合的5-HT1A受体部分激动剂以及5-HT2A和5-HT2C受体拮抗剂。惠氏公司试图将其开发为抗抑郁药，但最终没有得到推广。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It was developed as an antidepressant but never marketed, and no distinctive pattern of side effects has been established for it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它曾作為抗憂鬱藥開發，但從未上市，也沒有確立出特有的副作用模式。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它曾作为抗忧郁药开发，但从未上市，也没有确立出特有的副作用模式。

fact.en: It was designed to do two jobs at once, switching on one serotonin receptor while blocking two others, an early example of the deliberately multi-target drugs now common in psychiatry.
fact.zh: 它的設計是同時做兩件事：活化一個血清素受體，同時阻斷另外兩個；這是刻意設計的多標的藥物的早期例子，而這種做法如今在精神醫學中很常見。
fact.zhHans: 它的设计是同时做两件事：活化一个血清素受体，同时阻断另外两个；这是刻意设计的多标的药物的早期例子，而这种做法如今在精神医学中很常见。
